verdict.rationale: The only A/B testing evidence (mailerlite-docs-14) covers landing pages, not email campaigns. That is an adjacent feature and does not show subject-line or content-variant testing of campaigns, or automatic winner selection from engagement. The campaign evidence (mailerlite-docs-9) covers drafting, scheduling, sending and reports only, with no mention of split testing.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
